assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness, raising clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are episodic in nature.
There is a need to correlate rhythm disturbances with clinical events.
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods.
Cardiac event monitoring is performed with CPT code 93271.
The cardiac event monitoring supports the evaluation of diagnosis code I49.9.
The cardiac event monitoring supports the evaluation of diagnosis code I48.0.
The cardiac event monitoring supports the evaluation of diagnosis code R42.
